history.summary: Documented referent is the Budhwa Mahadev Mandir at Barkagaon, Hazaribagh district (Justdial listing: Pandaria, Barkagaon, Hazaribagh-825311; rated 4.4 from ~200 reviews; hours listed 6:00 AM-9:00 PM daily). Devotee videos show large crowds on Shravan Mondays and a Sawani mela at this shrine. FLAG - IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: 'Budhwa Mahadev' is the name of several shrines in Hazaribagh district - a Budhwa Mahadeva Temple is also listed at Bishnugarh (per onefivenine), and a Budhwa Mahadev site in Hazaribagh city hosts performances during the Ram Navami Shobha Yatra (per a 2026 Ram Navami video). The CSV row may intend any of these. FLAG - TOWN CORRECTED: CSV town 'Hazaribag' is approximate; this referent is at Barkagaon, ~15 km from Hazaribagh town. Coordinates are town-level (Barkagaon) approximations.

name: Budhwa Mahadev Mandir
town_description: Barkagaon is a town in Hazaribagh district, Jharkhand, about 15 km from Hazaribagh town. It is an important local settlement in the district's coal-mining belt and a centre of regional religious and cultural activity.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi is the nearest major airport (~90-100 km - verify); Deoghar Airport is another option (verify).
travel.railway: Hazaribagh Town station is the nearest railhead (~15-20 km - verify); Koderma Junction is the nearest major junction.
travel.road: Barkagaon lies on the Hazaribagh-Barkagaon road; reachable by taxi/auto from Hazaribagh town (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Shravan (July-August) for the Sawan crowds (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-9:00 PM daily (per Justdial listing - verify).
